findings.title: G6 corrected-subset project preflight and provider identity evidence are now persisted
findings.evidence: The official project_preflight.py run on configs/g6_project_preflight_verified23.json completed with 0 blockers and status READY_FOR_CONTROLLED_PILOT_NOT_RUN. The provider metadata endpoint returned HTTP 200 for glm-5 and its canonical metadata hash is persisted. The evidence is only model identity/creation metadata: the gateway supplied no immutable weight fingerprint, and no external billing receipt is present.
findings.remediation: Obtain an independently verifiable immutable model snapshot or gateway weight fingerprint and billing evidence; retain the current truthful preflight as a pilot-readiness attestation, not as full RUN_COMPLETE acceptance.

findings.title: Corrected paired-family cluster analysis is now persisted
findings.evidence: The 23-family corrected release has 552 matched rows and a deterministic paired-family bootstrap/McNemar analysis. Pooled G4-minus-G3 accuracy difference is -0.01811594202898551 with family-bootstrap 95% CI [-0.07608695652173915, 0.043478260869565216] and exact matched McNemar p=0.6353076420876663. CF3 is a prespecified exploratory stratum with difference -0.2753623188405797 and exact p=0.0005461. The analysis remains pending independent statistical review and does not justify causal or superiority claims.
findings.remediation: Have an independent reviewer inspect the preregistration, oracle provenance, paired-family construction, and statistical code before any confirmatory inference.

findings.title: Real-provider accounting is locally auditable but externally unverified
findings.evidence: The original raw run retains provider-error history and the corrected trace audit passes. Provider model identity metadata is now recorded, but no billing export or immutable weight snapshot is available for independent verification.
findings.remediation: Retain an independently verifiable provider billing export and immutable model snapshot, then repeat the final acceptance review.
